deviations_from_card: (1) Two commits, not three: the ADR and CHANGELOG ride with the voice commit (brief: shared-surface edits in the final commit under the lock). (2) lib/hands.ts not touched: callOnPage already returns reason; PageAnswer moved to lib/execute.ts and run.ts re-exports it. (3) Added one behaviour the card did not list: a voice decision.resolved with by=user lifts the hold on the card's action (ADR 0113 decision 3). Without it a spoken yes to an unsure tool's card would hold its own approved execute, since the gateway sends the execute as a plain tool.call after decision.resolved; this matches the panel, where answer() forgets before running the execute. Pinned by its own test (red before). (4) withUnsure takes a local structural type rather than run.ts's GatedLists, to keep lib/ from importing stores/. (5) lines_changed 821 is just over ~800: 312 are tests and ~250 are the mechanical move (139 deleted from run.ts, re-added in execute.ts).
notes: ADR number 0113 claimed under the lock (0112 was demo-kit's). run.ts keeps re-exports timeoutReasonOf (alias of readTimeout), isReadCall, unsureTools, withUnsure, UNSURE_CAP, Unsure, PageAnswer for harness-engines/B. voice.test.ts beforeEach now calls resetRunForTests() so the window's unsure set starts empty. No sibling reds seen on the apps/desktop gates.
